---
title: "STICS Evaluation Dashboard"
date: last-modified
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_common.R") # nolint: undesirable_function_linter.

evaluation_status <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "evaluation_status.csv"))
species_summary <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "species_summary.csv"))
usm_summary <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "usm_summary.csv"))
species_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path("csv", "species_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)

# Only the species of `species_stats.csv` get a page (see
# `get_species_list()` in render_report.R).
species_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "species_stats.csv"))
species_href <- function(species) {
  ifelse(
    species %in% species_stats$species,
    file.path("species", paste0(species, ".html")),
    NA_character_
  )
}
# Straight to the "Failed USMs" section of the species page.
failed_usms_href <- function(species) {
  links <- species_href(species)
  ifelse(is.na(links), NA_character_, paste0(links, "#failed-usms"))
}
```

## Evaluation status

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| eval: !expr '!is.null(evaluation_status)'
icons <- c(
  skip = '<span style="color:#888;">&#8211;</span>',
  pass = '<span style="color:#2ecc71;">&#10004;</span>',
  fail = '<span style="color:#e74c3c;">&#10008;</span>'
)

# `which()` drops NAs, so a missing status or success counts as FALSE.
not_eval <- which(evaluation_status$status == "not evaluated")
state <- rep("fail", nrow(evaluation_status))
state[which(evaluation_status$success)] <- "pass"
state[not_eval] <- "skip"

label <- htmltools::htmlEscape(evaluation_status$evaluation)
label[not_eval] <- sprintf(
  "%s (not evaluated: %s)",
  label[not_eval], htmltools::htmlEscape(evaluation_status$reason[not_eval])
)

cat(paste(icons[state], label, collapse = "&emsp;"), "\n\n")
```

## Species evaluation

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(species_summary)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  categories <- c(
    Critical = "Major degradation",
    Warning = "Minor degradation",
    OK = "No degradation"
  )

  blocks <- vapply(names(categories), function(status) {
    species <- species_summary$species[species_summary$status %in% status]
    sprintf(
      "<p><strong>%s</strong><br>\n%s</p>",
      categories[[status]], tag_list(species, status, href = species_href)
    )
  }, character(1))
  writeLines(c(
    '<div class="summary-block">',
    "<p>The following species show at least one variable with:</p>",
    blocks,
    "</div>\n\n"
  ))
}
```

### Overview by variable

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Overview heatmap of the species-level status of every variable
# (variables in rows, as there are many more of them than species; species
# in columns), from `species_rrmse_comparison.csv`. Species are sorted like
# the badges above (most degraded first), variables by the number of
# species where they are critical, then warning.
status_levels <- c("Not tested", "Improved", "Warning", "Critical")
overview <- species_comparison
if (!is.null(overview)) {
  overview <- overview[overview$status %in% status_levels, , drop = FALSE]
}
show_overview <- !is.null(overview) && nrow(overview) > 0

if (show_overview) {
  # Clicking a cell opens the species page, at the variable's scatter plot
  # for the degraded ones (the only ones with a scatter plot, see the
  # `scatter-<variable>` anchors of species.qmd).
  heatmap_href <- function(species, variable, status) {
    links <- species_href(species)
    degraded <- status %in% c("Critical", "Warning")
    ifelse(
      !is.na(links) & degraded,
      paste0(links, "#", scatter_id(variable)),
      links
    )
  }
  overview_plot <- SticsREval::overview_heatmap(
    overview, status_levels, href = heatmap_href
  )
  htmltools::div(class = "overview-scroll", overview_plot)
} else {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo overview available.\n:::\n\n")
}
```

::: {.callout-note}
    
Species-level status of each variable (rRMSE ratio vs. the reference version, over all the USMs of the species). Hover a cell for the details, click it to open the species page (at the variable's scatter plot when it is degraded). White cells are variables not evaluated for that species.

:::

## USM evaluation

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(usm_summary)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo USM evaluation data.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  cat('<div class="summary-block">\n')
  cat("<p>The following species have at least one failed USM:</p>\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Failed</strong><br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      usm_summary$species[usm_summary$failed_usms > 0], "Failed",
      href = failed_usms_href
    )
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Passed</strong> (all USMs ok)<br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      usm_summary$species[usm_summary$failed_usms == 0], "Passed",
      href = species_href
    )
  ))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```
